column5: Description
The small bones sewn into this armor strengthen it greatly. This does not restrict the movement of the wearer's arms.
This bow is as light as it is deadly. It was made from wood freely given by Brackenleaf himself.

column4: Belt of Vaulting of the Ranger
column5: This belt feels lighter than it looks.

column4: This strange hammer has a peculiar, earthy scent. When wielded below ground, its bearer constantly salivates.

column5: Brauti Bloodshark's cutlass is razor sharp. Several splotchy stains mar the blade itself.
These pauldrons change color in the light. The iridescent gleam is reminiscent of a magical portal.
This distinctive but not unpleasant odor permeating this armor is said to repel fleshflies.
Whatever is caked into the material will require powerful magic to remove.

column4: This garment is slippery to the touch. It appears to be a Khajiiti gift of state re-gifted to you by King Camoran Aeradan.
There is a tiny etching of an ear on the back of this amulet. In dim light, the etching glows faintly.

column5: This helm once belonged to General Endare. It bears the markings of a decorated Dominion general.
Daedric script lines the inside of the shield. The acrid smell reminds you of the prison bars in Coldharbour.

column4: These slippers vibrate softly when near sources of running water.

column5: This axe has dozens of tiny notches along the haft. A pair of fangs are fastened tightly to the grip.

column4: This ring is simple in its design. The wearer feels a distinct sense of calm and acceptance.

column5: This belt is warm to the touch. A secret compartment within appears large enough to hold three small vials.

column4: These fine boots are much lighter than they appear. They keep the wearer's feet completely dry.

column5: This staff is warm to the touch.
This axe's blade never dulls. Karthdar's citizens provided it to symbolically purge their town of items that offend the Green.
These boots smell of mildew and death.
This staff is quite ancient. While holding it, you can hear incredibly faint but indescribably beautiful singing.
This shirt crackles when you touch it.

column4: When clapped together, the sound made by these gloves is no louder than a whisper.
Time Buckler of the Green Pact
column5: This shield shimmers with faint purple light.

column4: A small note within this worn belt reads: "To Stibbons, for five years of entirely adequate service. -Laurent"

column2: Nindaeril the Monsoon and Bavura the Blizzard
column4: Nindaeril's Tooth of the Green Pact
column5: This tooth still has sinews attached to it and can fit around your neck.
This helm glows with a pale yellow light. It was long ago worn by the powerful necromancer Telacar.
This breastplate is cool to the touch.
This cowl is difficult to see in poor light. It does not impede the wearer's field of view.

column4: These gloves are well maintained, despite years of use. An advertisement for Redfur Trading Post is stitched within.
This small box contains a few potions that Bastian thought you might appreciate.

column5: These boots are caked in layers of ancient mud. They are all that remains of a slave who upset his Ayleid master.

column4: This sword emanates dark energy. When released, the hilt blackens the bearer's palms with greasy soot.
These robes are remarkably thin. They seem to be made from some strange kind of silk.

column5: This plate armor was made by Wood Orc smiths. It is thick, heavy, and well-constructed.

column4: This heavy breastplate is incredibly sturdy. Its simple construction shows the great skill of Barkbite smiths.

column5: This belt twitches slightly when objects are thrown at its wearer.
This peculiar crown looks too small to fit comfortably. When worn, the faint urge to dance is unrelenting.
These traveling breeches seem cool to the touch.
These immaculate pauldrons are of Ayleid design. Eminaire traded them to me for the fragments I brought her.
This hammer is only heavy when sheathed. It crackles and seems to lose half its weight in the bearer's hand.
This is all that remains of Rajhin's Mantle. Its curse-and much of its power-was burned away by the Orrery.
This staff is covered with a sticky coating.

column4: The hollow reservoir within this dagger seems patterned after some kind of fang. It only stops dripping when sheathed.

column5: Flames lick the blade of this massive sword.

column4: Valanir's Lost Hope of the Green Pact
column5: This staff emanates despair.

column4: Tough Mining Boots of the Ranger
column5: These boots look like they could stand up to anything.

column4: This staff smolders brightly in the darkness. If kept alight for too long, the bearer begins to crave roasted acorns.

column5: This staff smells of decay.

column4: These heavy gloves have a distinct alchemical smell. Dozens of acid spatters cover the metal.
